meta.interpretation: The user wants a single count of Pfizer-sponsored clinical trials in lung cancer, with a sense of how many are actually ongoing versus completed.
assumptions: 'Pfizer' is matched as sponsor or collaborator, so Pfizer-affiliated entities (e.g. Wyeth, a Pfizer subsidiary) and trials where Pfizer collaborates with an academic lead sponsor are included.
'Lung cancer' is passed as a condition term and expanded by the registry's own synonym/MeSH handling, covering NSCLC, SCLC and other lung carcinoma phrasings.
All trials are counted regardless of start date or status; the status breakdown shows how many are currently active/recruiting versus completed or stopped.
No study-type restriction, so observational as well as interventional studies are included.
meta.counting_semantics: Each trial is counted exactly once; bucket values partition the 248 analyzed trials.
